name: vllm-rocm-r9700-main
description: vLLM v0.22.0 runtime for the AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 (gfx1201, RDNA4) ASSEMBLED from a prebuilt upstream-vLLM wheel (vllm-rocm-r9700-main-wheel) installed --no-deps into the TheRock gfx1201 torch 2.10/rocm7.13 base (no official rocm/vllm gfx1201 base exists). Replaces the base's broken prerelease vllm 0.19.1 whose gfx1201 attention/MoE kernels produce garbage output. No source compile in this image (~2 min); rebuild the wheel pkg (vllm-rocm-r9700-main-wheel) first when bumping VLLM_TAG or the TheRock base. Build host 9700x8 (32-core EPYC). ROCm is the _rocm_sdk_devel pip package, so ROCM_PATH/HIP_PATH point there, not /opt/rocm.
